title: Security
description: Enterprise single sign-on (SSO), SCIM user provisioning and IP restrictions.
forbidden: You don't have permission to manage security settings.
load_failed: Security settings could not be loaded.
plan_note: SSO, SCIM and IP restrictions are Enterprise plan features.
copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
sso.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.description: Let your members sign in with your own identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace…).
sso.enabled_hint: While off, sign-in with the identity provider cannot start.
sso.client_secret_hint: Write-only; leave empty to keep the stored value.
sso.redirect_uri: Redirect URI (add it to your identity provider)
sso.metadata_hint: Paste your identity provider's metadata XML or upload it from a file.
sso.test_start_failed: SSO sign-in could not start. Check the configuration and plan features.
sso.test_ok_body: The identity provider response was verified and a SCIM-provisioned user matched. This session is now verified with SSO for the organization, so you can turn on enforcement.
sso.test_failed_body: The response could not be verified or the user is not provisioned via SCIM. Check the issuer, client details, metadata and the user's SCIM record.
enforce.title: Enforced SSO
enforce.description: While on, only sessions opened with SSO can access the organization; members signed in with a password are blocked.
enforce.label: Require SSO
enforce.hint: Test that admins can sign in with SSO before turning this on.
enforce.needs_sso: Enable and save SSO first to enforce it.
enforce.session_note: For safety, enforcement can only be turned on from a session verified with SSO; requests from a password session are rejected. Use “Test sign-in” above to verify this session first.
enforce.on_description: Every member signed in with a password loses access to the organization until they verify with SSO. If the SSO setup breaks, the team can be locked out.
enforce.off_description: Members can sign in with a password again.
scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.description: Your identity provider adds, updates and deactivates users and groups automatically over SCIM 2.0.
scim.token_hint: Creating a new token revokes the old one at once. SSO must be configured and saved.
scim.rotate_description: The current token stops working immediately; update your identity provider with the new token.
scim.issued_description: Enter these values in your identity provider's SCIM settings.
scim.shown_once: The token is shown only once. Copy it before closing this dialog.
allowlist.title: IP restrictions
allowlist.description: The organization can only be reached from these IP addresses or blocks (CIDR). With an empty list there is no restriction.
allowlist.invalid: Enter a valid IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR block (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24).
allowlist.too_many: At most 100 rules can be added.
allowlist.empty: No rules; the organization can be reached from any IP.
allowlist.lockout_body: Your current IP ({{ip}}) is not in this list. If you save, this session loses access to the organization. Add your IP first.
allowlist.confirm_description: Every request from outside these {{count}} rules, including the API and mobile app, is rejected.
allowlist.confirm_clear: All rules are removed; the organization can be reached from any IP.
errors.ip_lockout: Not saved: the list does not include your current IP and would lock you out.
errors.forbidden: You can't make this change. SSO can only be enforced from an SSO session.
errors.entitlement: This feature is not in your plan. Upgrade to Enterprise.
errors.invalid: The configuration is invalid. Make sure URLs use https and the metadata is valid.
validation.https: Enter a valid URL starting with https://.
validation.xml: Enter valid metadata XML (at most 1 MB).
errors.enforce_needs_sso: Not saved: verify this session with “Test sign-in” first. Enforcement can only be turned on from an SSO session.
sso.login_link: Sign-in link for members (share with your team)
